optimizedContext.value:
# Config

## Rules
### Discovery and cascade
- `--config <file>`: forced single entrypoint plus its own `extends`; never add discovered layers.
- Otherwise walk CWD toward nearest VCS root; stop at first directory with candidates. Outside VCS, inspect CWD only. Candidate order: `specd.yaml`, `specd.*.yaml` alpha, `specd.local.yaml`, `specd.local.*.yaml` alpha.
- `extends:true` inherits previous active layer; `extends:<path>` activates only when base already belongs to chain. Never traverse above VCS root. Host discovery root follows same rules; explicitly unconfigured command modes allowed.
- Merge: scalar last-wins; objects deep-merge; arrays append. `remove` valid only with `extends`; required `schema` non-removable. Identities: `context[].id`, `plugins.agents[].name`, keyed `workspaces`/`storage`. No arbitrary selectors.
- Reject invalid `extends`, detached path base, standalone `remove`, missing/ambiguous removal target, removal of required field. `specd init` gitignores `specd.local.yaml` and `specd.local.*.yaml`.

### Core settings
- Required `schema`: `@scope/name`, `#workspace:name`, `#name`/bare as default workspace, or relative/absolute path. Prefix selects exact resolver; one project schema only. Resolve at dispatch; skip help/version/init/config validate/plugin. Distinguish `ConfigValidationError`, `SchemaNotFoundError`, `SchemaValidationError`.
- Optional `schemaPlugins` use same references, must be `kind: schema-plugin`, applied after base `extends` chain in order. Then apply structurally validated `schemaOverrides` using `create|remove|set|append|prepend`.
- `privacy.mode`: `hash|mask|anonymous`; hash requires salt. Optional `salt`, `excludeActors` default `["specd","system@getspecd.dev"]`, `allowedMetadataKeys`. Environment overrides: `SPECD_ACTOR_PROVIDER`, `SPECD_PRIVACY_SALT`, `SPECD_PRIVACY_MODE` including `.env`/`.env.local`. `actorProvider` forces registry provider.
- Structured `invalidation: {artifacts,workflow}`: artifacts `none|surgical|downstream|global`; workflow `preserve|redesign`; new-change default `{artifacts:downstream,workflow:preserve}`. Deprecated `invalidationPolicy` maps to artifacts value + `workflow:redesign`; both forms together invalid. Policy cannot alter topology or waive freshness/approval recovery.
- Unknown `{{namespace.key}}` template token remains unchanged and warns.

### Workspaces
- Require `default`; reserve `root` for graph and reject declaration. Names follow `/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/`.
- Each workspace requires `specs.adapter`; v1 supports `fs` with required path. Relative paths resolve from config directory; external path sets `isExternal`.
- Optional explicit `specs.adapter.config.metadataPath` resolves absolute and is retained for repository wiring. If absent, kernel—not loader—derives from specs-path VCS root or parent.
- Default workspace: `codeRoot` defaults project root, `ownership:owned`, `schemas` defaults `.specd/schemas`. Non-default: `codeRoot` required, `ownership:readOnly`, no schema store unless declared. `shared` writable.
- Workspace context filters and graph settings allowed. `graph.allowedPaths` relative to `codeRoot`; `respectGitignore=true` gives gitignore absolute priority; explicit `excludePaths` replaces built-ins and supports negation.
- Named storage adapters pass adapter-owned config; unknown adapter name fails.

### Storage and paths
- Optional `storage` bindings for changes/drafts/discarded/archive use generic adapter shape. Missing binding defaults to fs under `specdPath`.
- `specdPath` defaults `.specd`; derive absolute `configPath`, graph/tmp roots, and `{configPath}/tmp/change-locks`. Loader verifies all resolved directories and throws `StorageDirectoryNotFoundError`.
- `SpecdStorageConfig` exposes raw adapter bindings and absolute staging paths.

### Context
- Project `contextIncludeSpecs`/`contextExcludeSpecs` always apply; workspace patterns apply only when active through change `specIds`. Bare qualifier means `default` at project level, current workspace at workspace level.
- Pattern `*` allowed only alone, as `workspace:*`, or terminal `prefix/*`. Exact IDs do not match descendants. Defaults: project include `default:*`; workspace include `*`; excludes empty.
- Compile order: project `context[]`; project includes then excludes; active-workspace includes then excludes in declaration order; transitive `dependsOn`. Dependency-reached specs ignore exclusions. Deduplicate at first inclusion.
- Dependency resolution precedence: `change.specDependsOn`, persisted metadata, content extraction. Unknown qualifier warns runtime but fails `config validate`; nonexistent spec skips; invalid syntax fails startup; unmatched valid patterns warn during validation.
- `contextMode`: project-only `list|summary|full|hybrid`, default `summary`; reject legacy `lazy` and workspace-level declaration.
- `context[]` entries: instruction or file, optional stable `id`; paths relative to declaring active config.

### Approvals, logging, graph, plugins
- `approvals.spec` and `approvals.signoff` default false. Spec gate blocks forward exit from `ready`; signoff blocks `done→archivable`. Missing/stale consent yields `APPROVAL_REQUIRED`; redesign bypasses spec approval. Await in `ready`/`done`, never happy-path pending states; legacy pending states drain compatibly.
- `logging.level`: `trace|debug|info|warn|error|silent`, default `info`.
- `llmOptimizedContext` project opt-in boolean, default false.
- Project `graph.includePaths` discovers unowned resources as `root:`; `graph.excludePaths` applies globally and cannot be overridden by workspace filters.
- Validate `plugins.agents?: Array<{name,config?}>` via strict Zod; reject unknown plugin types.
- `ConfigWriter`: `initProject`, idempotent `addPlugin`, `removePlugin`, `listPlugins`.
- Legacy-compatible shapes produce non-fatal `SpecdConfig.warnings`; omitted storage defaults produce none.

## Constraints
- Strict Zod validation at load; reject unknown top-level fields.
- Every project has default workspace and one active schema.
- `privacy.mode=hash` requires config/environment salt.
- Cascade failures surface as `ConfigValidationError`; missing resolved directories as `StorageDirectoryNotFoundError`.
